summary: Average the translated coefficient over the Bessel graph: W(y) = ∫_S psiInFrame(l, x⁻¹s₁y)·wave(−σ(s₁))· rep(s₂)⁻¹v dν_S(s). It transforms correctly under S (right invariance of ν_S), is reproduced by the idempotent kernel deg(l)·psiInFrame(l, ·), is bounded by the decay integral, and ⟨v, W(x)⟩ = ∫θ dν_S, so La gives ν_S{…} ≤ b^n‖W(x)‖; in particular W(x) ≠ 0.
